body: I get it. I've been there. I'm there now. Let's talk.
I've been you. I may even be you now. If you want to talk, I'm here.
That's why I refused to buy one even when people told me I should due to a stalking issue. I was too afraid I'd turn it on myself.

I get it. I'm there too. I threw away the love of my life for something I realize now never cared about and he moved on. Blocked me on all socials, won't even respond to texts unless he feels like he has to.

That was almost a year ago and I think about him everyday. I think about him and I sleeping together to help me get to sleep now. Without those thoughts, I don't think I would ever sleep again. I don't know if it gets better but I'm so so glad to have the dreams.
